# Adin AI

> Adin AI is a 100% free AI-powered career platform. Build professional, ATS-friendly CVs, generate tailored cover letters and get career help — no signup, no credit card, no ads. Download as PDF, PNG or TXT.

Website: https://getadinai.com

## Main pages
- [Home](https://getadinai.com/): Free CV builder, cover letter generator and career assistant
- [Free CV Builder](https://getadinai.com/free-cv-builder): Build an ATS-friendly CV online for free, no signup
- [Free Cover Letter Generator](https://getadinai.com/free-cover-letter-generator): Generate a professional cover letter for free, no signup
- [Free CV Templates](https://getadinai.com/templates): Professional, ATS-friendly CV templates
- [Free Cover Letter Templates](https://getadinai.com/cover-templates): Professional cover letter templates
- [Blog](https://getadinai.com/blog): Career tips, CV and cover letter advice for job seekers in Pakistan
- [Founder](https://getadinai.com/founder): About Kian Mercer, founder of Adin AI
- [Contact](https://getadinai.com/contact): Support and feedback
